title: unified-rollouts-proactive-rollback-workflows-canary-ab-shadow
author: Maya Chen
description: Implements proactive automated rollback workflows for unified rollouts to handle canary, A/B and shadow traffic modes. Motivation: reduce blast radius and mean time to recovery when model regressions are detected by moving from reactive human-driven rollbacks to policy-driven automated rollbacks that consider multi-metric thresholds and stability guards. This change introduces a new orchestration layer in the rollout controller that evaluates metric matchers, composite thresholds, and probing results to decide whether to trigger an automatic rollback or a staged mitigation (reduce traffic, trigger shadow probing). The PR includes: controller changes (rollback orchestration, job scheduling, backoff/retry), new policy types and CRD fields for proactive_rollback configuration, multi-metric matcher with weighting, observability hooks for detailed rollback traces, additional e2e tests and unit tests, and docs + examples for configuring proactive rollback workflows. Behavior notes: automated rollback only triggers when configured on the rollout policy and after a configurable stabilization window; safety guards prevent cascading rollbacks across multiple rollouts; canary and A/B rollouts support weighted-step rollback and partial-deactivation; shadow probing can be used to confirm regressions before rolling back production traffic. See commits, changed files, and CI summary below.

review_comments: Arjun: Overall looks good but concerned about potential race when multiple controllers observe the same metric spike. Can we add a leader-elected guard or stronger compare-and-swap semantics?
Lena: Need clearer docs for safety guards; what happens if a downstream model fails its probe during a staged rollout?
Tom: e2e flaky on first run, failing in 'shadow probing success' expectation; suspect timing assumptions in test harness. Also request instrumentation to emit reason codes for automated rollbacks.
author_responses: Maya: Added a controller-level mutex and leader election check; controller now uses CAS on rollout status to avoid double-triggering. See fix in f1a2b3c.
Maya: Expanded docs with explicit safety guard behavior and examples for partial-deactivation; added a new config flag 'prevent-chained-rollbacks' to avoid cascading actions.

Maya: Flaky e2e investigated and fixed by adding a probe-retry backoff in the test harness; added explicit retry and extended timeouts where probing interacts with shadow pods. Instrumentation now emits 'rollback_reason' tag in traces.
release_notes: Add proactive automated rollback workflows for unified rollouts. New configuration options for canary/A-B/shadow rollouts, multi-metric matchers, safety guards to avoid chained rollbacks, and observability for rollback events. Backward compatible by default; opt-in via rollout policy.
notes_for_release: Opt-in feature behind rollout.policy.proactiveRollback; operators should read docs and test in staging before enabling in production. Recommended: attach metric matchers for latency and error-rate and enable shadow probing for high-risk models.
